title: Read the Anthropic text block even when a thinking block comes first

files.patch:
@@ -53,10 +53,19 @@ def get_oneoff_message(instructions, messages, params = {}, json: false)
       @client.send(client_method_name, ** @client_config)
     end
 
-    response.dig("content", 0, "text") ||
+    self.class.content_text(response) ||
       response.dig("choices", 0, "message", "content")
   end
 
+  # The text of an Anthropic-style response. Models that think by default can put
+  # a thinking block first, so this looks for the text block rather than taking the first one.
+  def self.content_text(response)
+    content = response["content"]
+    return nil unless content.is_a?(Array)
+
+    content.find { |block| block["type"] == "text" }&.dig("text")
+  end
+

@@ -439,6 +439,16 @@ class AIBackend::AnthropicTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
     end

+  test "one-off reads the text block when a thinking block comes first" do
+    TestClient::Anthropic.stub :thinking, "" do
+      TestClient::Anthropic.stub :text, "{\"topic\":\"Weekend plans\"}" do
+        reply = @anthropic.get_oneoff_message("Extract a topic.", ["Here is chat text."], json: true)
+
+        assert_equal "Weekend plans", JSON.parse(reply)["topic"], "the reply should come from the text block, not the thinking block before it"
+      end
+    end
+  end
